conversation.user: I'm in Construction Management Bachelor of Technology.
conversation.advisor:
You’re in the **Construction Management Bachelor of Technology** program.

### Program overview
- **Credential:** Bachelor of Technology / Bachelor’s Degree  
- **School:** School of Construction and the Environment  
- **Campus:** Burnaby  
- **Delivery:** In person  
- **Study mode:** Full-time or part-time  
- **Status:** Active  
- **Overview:** A degree-completion program developing management, technical, and interpersonal construction-project skills.

### Curriculum

**Construction Controls and Techniques**
- **CMGT 7160** — Statistics for Construction Management  
- **CMGT 7190** — Construction Planning and Controls  
- **Display course code not provided** — CMGT 7211 — Heavy Equipment in Construction  
- **Display course code not provided** — CMGT 7400 — Project Planning for Quality & Risk Management  

**Organization Management — 12 credits**
- **BUSA 7250** — Management Skills and Applications  
- **CMGT 7330** — Finance for Construction Managers  
- **CMGT 7420** — Construction Law  
- **Display course code not provided** — CMGT 8435 — Construction Enterprise Management  

**Stakeholder Engagement — 9 credits**
- **CMGT 7535** — Leadership and Interpersonal Skills  
- **Display course code not provided** — CMGT 7660 — Environmental Considerations in Construction  
- **Display course code not provided** — CMGT 8602 — Engagement of Project Stakeholders  

**Management electives — at least 4 credits from the approved pool**
Examples include:
- **CMGT 7125** — Construction Schedule and Delay Analysis  
- **CMGT 7220** — Health and Safety in Construction  
- **CMGT 7605** — Industrial Relations  
- **CMGT 7840** — Technical Presentations  
- **EENG 7000** — Introduction to Climate Change, Ecology, and Systems Thinking  
- **TMGT 7102** — Project Management/Resource Utilization  
- **TMGT 7145** — Leadership in a World of Change  

The complete approved pool also includes additional CMGT and TMGT electives. External management courses may be approved toward this requirement.

**Liberal Studies — 12 credits**
- **LIBS 7001** — Critical Reading and Writing  
- **LIBS 7002** — Applied Ethics  
- **Display course code not provided** — Race, Class and Gender: Intersections  

Part-time students may replace **LIBS 7013 — Race, Class and Gender: Intersections** with 3 additional approved Liberal Studies elective credits; the other Liberal Studies requirements remain.

**Professional Standards**
- **CMGT 7810** — Advanced Industry Communication  
- **CMGT 8211** — Industry Collaborations  
- **CMGT 8700** — Industry Based Project Proposal  
- After completing **CMGT 8700 — Industry Based Project Proposal**, choose **one** final project:
  - **CMGT 8800** — Industry Based Project, or
  - **CMGT 8810** — Industry Based Project

### Stored program requirements
- **CMGT 8700 — Industry Based Project Proposal** requires completion of the required program coursework, at least two years of related work experience, an industry topic, and an industry sponsor.
- **CMGT 8800 — Industry Based Project** and **CMGT 8810 — Industry Based Project** require completion of the required program coursework before the chosen final-project course, plus department approval.
- The standard Liberal Studies component totals **12 credits**.

Program page:  
https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/
